title: vtc-00: per-viewer playback authorisation
description: Viewers obtain a short-lived playback credential from the server instead of relying on a static URL: an opaque string with an expiry, obtained via a method or a per-viewer server-set property. How it is presented (query parameter, bearer token, cookie) is per protocol and out of scope; the spec only says a viewer presents it to the playback endpoint. Hook point for a paid gate ticket (payments extension) turning into a playback credential.
